summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running any tests, Black, or repository code, and without committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" formatting entry and Control.title(title), which returns an unstyled control carrying one SET_WINDOW_TITLE entry. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches the control to term.set_title(title) once. rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool, gated on is_terminal the same way show_cursor is, and never calls Windows APIs. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. New tests cover Control.title, the Windows renderer (Windows only, mocked), and Console.set_window_title (skipped on Windows). Choices to confirm: I read the spec's "show_cursor passes" wording as the same is_terminal gating, and I added the str member to the ControlCode union. Test, Black, and formatting results are unverified.
